title: The AI Sell Off is HERE   3 Stocks to BUY the DIP on
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
summary: Mark Roussin's weekly playbook argues the AI selloff, compounded by hot inflation data — CPI at 3.7% and PPI up 6.3% year on year — is a buying opportunity, and reads the falling 10-year Treasury yield during the selloff as a defensive rotation into safety rather than simple rate relief: consumer staples, healthcare and energy led the past month while AI and semiconductors took the selling. He stresses investors now ask what companies will earn from AI spending, not just how much is spent, so selectivity matters. Using FastGraphs (the video's sponsor), he features three dip buys. VRT — BUY, first tracked: Vertiv's power, cooling and liquid-cooling for AI data centres, earnings expected up 36% next year, PEG under 1, health score about 80 and net debt/EBITDA of 0.2, with roughly 30–40% upside on his multiples; the bear case is exposure to any AI capex slowdown. NVDA — BUY, reiterated: about 10% off highs at 13.5x next-year earnings, with $315 possible by the end of Q1 next year at 20x, on the full platform and CUDA moat; bear case is capex-ROI questions and custom-chip competition. AVGO — BUY, reiterated, added at the end of last week: custom AI chips and networking, revenue up 86%, AI semiconductor revenue up 220% and record free cash flow at about 17x forward; bear case is meaningful debt. He also briefly discloses recently adding AMD — BUY, flipping his 13 October CONDITIONAL_BUY to BUY.

calls.bear_case: Not immune to an AI slowdown: if big tech cuts capex or delays data-centre projects, growth suffers.
